visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a 2D animated character named Shaogao, a yellow figure with a mustache and glasses, sitting in a plush blue armchair in a well-decorated study. He holds a white mug with 'WORLD'S BEST BF' written on it and appears to be relaxing near a brick fireplace with a lit fire. To his right is a floor-to-ceiling bookshelf filled with books, a skull, and a globe, while a framed portrait of a girl and an onion-like creature hangs on the wall. (2) The scene cuts to a series of flat illustrations depicting Shaogao and a pink-haired girl in various domestic conflicts. They argue over the orientation of a toilet paper roll, the correct way to squeeze a tube of toothpaste, and the optimal cooking time for a pot of instant noodles on a stove. Each sub-scene features expressive facial animations, such as furrowed brows and shouting mouths, and red 'X' or question mark symbols to emphasize the disagreement. (3) Shaogao returns to the study scene, now gesturing with one finger held up while looking directly at the camera. A blue background appears behind him with a dense list of potential activities one could do in 1000 hours, such as traveling the world, starting a business, or watching reels. He looks energetic and uses wide hand motions to convey his point about saving time. (4) The visual transitions to a vertical screen capture of a smartphone interface, showing the Shopee app. The UI displays menus for the 'Affiliate Program' (蝦皮分潤計畫) with red icons and text buttons. Shaogao remains visible in the bottom-right corner as a small inset figure, pointing at the screen elements and nodding as the interface scrolls through various steps of joining the program and selecting products like Adidas shoes. (5) The final phase shows Shaogao in the study once more, holding a large white sign with the referral code 'SE77HSE' in bold black text. He smiles and gestures enthusiastically toward the sign as he encourages viewers to join. The lighting is consistently bright and flat throughout, characteristic of modern web animation.
